01-ready-with-required-fail.json.why: Earlier review case 1: READY while a required control is FAIL.

02-ready-with-zero-controls.json.why: Earlier review case 2: READY with no controls evaluated (vacuous pass).

03-pass-with-empty-evidence.json.why: Earlier review case 3: PASS with no evidence.

04-unknown-profile-and-extra-key.json.why: Earlier review case 4: unknown profile and an extra top-level key.

05-missing-impact-and-verification.json.why: Earlier review case 5: control without impact and recommended_verification.

06-blocking-fail-in-optional-group-not-b.why: A blocking FAIL (committed secret) in an optional group must still force NOT_READY.

07-not-applicable-marked-required.json.why: A NOT_APPLICABLE control cannot be required.

08-not-ready-without-trigger.json.why: NOT_READY must be justified by a required FAIL/UNVERIFIED or a blocking FAIL.

09-governed-platform-skips-governance.js.why: governed-platform must report governance as PASS, FAIL or UNVERIFIED.

10-required-but-not-blocking.json.why: Only blocking controls can be required.
